interpretation: The 370 rows are 74 repeated equation families measured under five seeds; seeds are repeated runs, not 370 independent equation families. Cross-seed summaries are calculated within equation_id. Clipped R² uses [-10, 1] and is reported separately from raw R².

paired_delta_across_seed_records_descrip.warning: Descriptive repeated-seed pairs; not an independent-sample significance test. Intractable cases are summarized separately per seed.
